AI Engineer
Job title: AI Engineer
Department: Global Legal, Intellectual Property, and Security (GLIPS)
Company: Novo Nordisk GBS, Bangalore
Shape the future of AI at Novo Nordisk and drive transformative solutions that support life-saving work across our global legal and intellectual property operations.
The position
As an AI Engineer, you'll be at the forefront of our AI transformation journey, building and deploying cutting-edge AI solutions that create lasting impact across Novo Nordisk. This role offers the unique opportunity to work at the intersection of emerging technology and mission-critical business functions, where your technical expertise will directly enable our purpose of defeating serious chronic diseases.
Your responsibilities will include:
Building, deploying, and maintaining robust, efficient, and compliant AI-centric solutions from proof of concepts through MVPs to mature products used across Novo Nordisk
Navigating complex business domains and corporate structures to engage with technical and non-technical colleagues, helping them harness the power of AI
Staying at the forefront of the rapidly evolving AI landscape and actively contributing to shaping Novo Nordisk's AI vision and strategy
Spearheading the early adoption and utilization of novel technologies with long-term potential for our organization
Creating and driving AI and data-centric projects and initiatives with self-sufficiency and strategic thinking
Updating technical documentation, participating in team and external meetings, and actively contributing to the ideation of innovative solutions
Conveying deep technical expertise to stakeholders across all levels, making complex AI concepts accessible and actionable
Qualifications
We're searching for a highly motivated and self-driven team player with excellent communication skills who can successfully collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You'll bring with you:
A Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or a similar field, along with proven work experience in AI or ML/NLP
Demonstrated contribution to Agentic AI products currently in production, with deep expertise in taking AI or NLP-based applications from idea to production
Strong proficiency with Python-based, AI-centric frontend technologies such as Chainlit and Streamlit
Experience taking an AI-related startup or scaleup from early stages to maturity, including hands-on work with AI agents and multi-agent systems
Deep technical expertise across the AI stack including vector databases, data pipelines, knowledge graphs, and AI architecture
Fluency with CI/CD pipelines, preferably Github Actions, and expertise with DevOps and deployment orchestrators, particularly Kubernetes
Deep expertise with Docker-based development environments and deployments
Proficiency in MS Azure and Amazon AWS, especially their AI offerings (Azure OpenAI and Bedrock)
Familiarity with Terraform and/or cloud agnostic Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
Bonus qualifications: Experience with Google Cloud, Vector Databases, Semantic Search, and Language Models

Title AI Engineer
Department AI Platform / Enterprise Technology Services (ETS)
Location Bangalore/Gurgaon

About your role You will play a key part in developing the core building blocks of Fidelitys Enterprise AI Platform. Your work will enable teams across the business to use AI in a secure, governed and scalable way. You will design and implement platform features, reusable components, and APIs that support high-quality AI development. You will help integrate new capabilities such as RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, observability and fine-tuning workflows. Working closely with engineering, architecture and governance functions, you will ensure that what you build is reliable, compliant and ready for enterprise use. Youll also contribute to documentation, automation and engineering best practices that strengthen the platform and improve developer experience.
About you You have strong hands-on experience building AI solutions using LLMs, RAG pipelines and modern agent frameworks like LangChain or LangGraph. You are comfortable developing APIs, SDKs and scalable components in Python. You understand vector databases and retrieval techniques, and you can apply evaluation tools to measure model quality. You bring solid engineering skills across cloud-native development and containerized deployments. You are also familiar with responsible AI, guardrails and good governance practices. Above all, you enjoy solving complex technical problems and building capabilities others can rely on.
